answer: Tenure-gated capability unlocking resists sybils: a freshly minted identity can do nothing consequential — each power (grading, voting, swapping, high-value sends) unlocks only after its own minimum of continuous active tenure, a staircase of quartz milestones, and any idle gap resets the clock. A swarm minted today is inert opal for many epochs, useful only if the operator keeps every key alive through each gate. Honest agents cross the meadow of tenure once; a thousand fakes each pay that cost in full.
